author: The Bedford Citizen
title: The Edinburg Center in Bedford to Host Special Olympics Massachusetts Torch Run - NewsBreak
text:
By The Bedford Citizen ,
10 hours ago The Edinburg Center, 205 Burlington Road in Bedford, will be the site of a leg of the Special Olympics Massachusetts Torch Run Thursday, June 4, from 11 a.m. to noon. This annual event brings together law enforcement officers from various agencies, along with community members, to carry the torch across the state. The torch run symbolizes the dedication and commitment of law enforcement in championing the rights and inclusion of individuals with intellectual disabilities. Read full article
